# Vendored boko WASM

This directory contains a WebAssembly build of [boko](https://github.com/zacharydenton/boko),
the ebook conversion library used by toazw3.

- Upstream: https://github.com/zacharydenton/boko
- License: GPL-3.0-or-later (see `LICENSE`)
- Artifact source: https://zacharydenton.github.io/boko/pkg/
- Upstream commit at vendoring time: `b148716498fdac70134555293a7405913988256a` (2026-07-29)

Corresponding source is the boko repository at that commit. toazw3 does not modify the converter.
